# Rate Of Change

*Percent change over N bars.*

**Kind** indicator · **Drawn** in its own pane

## Try it

On the chart, press <kbd>/</kbd> and choose **Rate Of Change** under **Oscillators**. To change it, copy the source below into the AlphaScript editor.

## Inputs

| Input | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Length | int | `9` |
| Source | source | `"close"` |
| Color | color | `"#2962FF"` |

## Source

From `packages/alphascript/indicators/roc.as.js`.

```js
indicator({ name: "Rate Of Change", shortTitle: "ROC", overlay: false, precision: 2 });
const length = input.int("Length", 9, { min: 1 });
plot(ta.roc(input.source("Source", "close"), length), { title: "ROC", color: input.color("Color", "#2962FF", { group: "Style" }) });
hline(0, { title: "Zero line", color: "#787B86" });
```
